description: Defines the PlacementInfo class used for managing layout placement details in OrchardCore, including zone parsing and delimiter-based extraction methods.

classes.name: PlacementInfo
classes.description: Represents layout placement information with methods to parse location strings and extract layout zones, positions, groups, cards, and columns.

methods.name: IsLayoutZone
methods.description: Checks if the placement location indicates a layout zone (starts with '/').

methods.name: IsHidden
methods.description: Determines if the placement is hidden based on Location being null, empty, or equal to the HiddenLocation constant.

methods.name: GetZones
methods.description: Returns an array of zone names parsed from the Location string, splitting on '.' and handling layout zone markers.

methods.name: GetPosition
methods.description: Extracts the position part from the Location string based on the PositionDelimiter ':'

methods.name: GetTab
methods.description: Extracts the tab information from the Location string based on the TabDelimiter '#'.

methods.name: GetGroup
methods.description: Extracts group information from the Location string based on the GroupDelimiter '@'.

methods.name: GetCard
methods.description: Extracts card information from the Location string based on the CardDelimiter '%'.

methods.name: GetColumn
methods.description: Extracts column information from the Location string based on the ColumnDelimiter '|'.
